changelog: 5.9.23 (Build 5923): Weather widget is movable again - drag it anywhere, it remembers its spot, tap still opens Weather. Ruby.ai gets a front-and-center API Key button - paste your OpenAI key once, it is saved on your device only and Ruby.ai will use it to chat.

New update system: RubyOS now counts and remembers updates on your browser, shows a 1-minute updating screen with time left while it checks every app, shows a red roadblock screen if something is broken, and goes back to your last working version if an update keeps failing.
